ratings_why.fun: Clean curve: Button and Pallbearer grow from turn 2, Puffwell sets the build at Tier 5 and Bootlace doubles it, and every death on a losing or winning board feeds the next turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Making change with Fruits that pay in reading order is a placement puzzle no current tribe has, though a stored counter is now the third of its kind.

verdict_why: The cards read and work as written, and the hot spots are balance for the owner, so another pass would make it different, not better.

points.text: Bellows Puffwell repeats with no cap, so late gold turns straight into board-wide stats through Hired Mute (3 gold buys a Tier 6 unit, selling it pays 6 Compost, which is one fire). If the owner finds it runs hot, 'up to three times' keeps the idea.
Say whether Bootlace's free repeat on Clerk Inkcap also costs it 1 Health; a player will want to know how long the clerk lasts.
Let Wake-Feast Cook skip Spores, so its permanent growth never lands on a unit that leaves after the fight.
Foxfire Lantern-bearer's +2/+2 cap stops mattering by Tier 5; a golden-style late scale, or a 'per 4 Compost' with no cap but touching only, would keep it in late boards.
The turn-start preview of which Fruits fire and what is left over is what makes the change puzzle fun, not a chore; build it with the tribe.

standouts.why: A clear Tier 5 direction card: one placement choice (F1 or B3) changes the whole turn's spending.
A true capstone that doubles everything the build already does, readable at a glance.
A Tier 1 seed that rewards exact change from the first Compost turn and stays relevant late.

weakest.why: Capped at +2/+2, it falls off once real stats arrive.
Twice a fight at +1/+1 is a slow scaler beside Pallbearer, and gaps cut it off.
Fills the hoard but does little on its own; easy to skip unless you are on Ashcake.

flags.note: Uncapped repeats: with Hired Mute (golden pays 12 per Tier 6 sale), Three-Rain Mourner and Bootlace, gold converts into +2/+2-to-all fires with no ceiling.
At Tier 6, buy-to-sell pays 6 Compost per 3 gold (12 golden), the fuel behind the Puffwell spike.
+6/+6 to every unit each fight once 12 Compost sits idle; bounded, but strong early in Tier 6.
